verses.76:10: إِنَّا نَخَافُ مِن رَّبِّنَا يَوۡمًا عَبُوسࣰ ا قَمۡطَرِيرࣰ ا

meaning: The root قمطر (qmTr) describes something intensely difficult or distressing. A "day qamṭarīr" is a calamitous day that makes one frown. It can also refer to intense evil.
en_note: Manually curated for a Quranic hapax root.
